beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Revocable Nobility asks how elite authority can end before disaster becomes its only auditor.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book starts from the need for capable leadership, rather than denying hierarchy.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A human and AI inquiry tests different contracts around power and status.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its models offer conditional hints, never a machine-certified constitution or forecast.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The reader examines whether office can remain answerable without turning every disagreement into removal.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: One experiment changes the question from who wins office to what office rewards afterward.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Ceremonial accountability can protect a leader who controls the records and interpretation of failure.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Constant removal threats can create a different failure by making every difficult decision unsafe.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book compares these conditions through explicit model assumptions rather than claiming measured future outcomes.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its central distinction is between choosing a person and constraining the authority that person receives.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The wider inquiry connects scarcity, status, surveillance, mobility, and the cognitive burden of public judgment.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its narrator describes provisional interpretations from a human and AI collaboration.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The final human coda asks how complex institutions can remain intelligible enough to contest.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Technical sophistication cannot itself establish consent or grant the machine a final political word.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Those limits keep the proposal open to criticism instead of announcing a perfected elite.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Begin with the author’s note and the method explaining what the models can show.
